events.summary:
The National Weather Service in Boise has issued a Fire Weather
Watch for lightning, which is in effect from Thursday afternoon
through Thursday evening.

* AFFECTED AREA...In Idaho, Fire Weather Zones 403 Northern
Boise National Forest, 421 Southern Boise/Western Sawtooth NF
and including the Camas Prairie. In Oregon, Fire Weather Zones
670 Burns BLM, 671 Steens Mountain, 674 Northwestern Vale BLM
and 675 Baker Valley.

* TIMING...From Thursday afternoon through Thursday evening.

* THUNDERSTORMS...Scattered coverage with abundant lightning.

* OUTFLOW WINDS...Gusty erratic winds up to 50 mph.

* IMPACTS...Any fire that develops will catch and spread
quickly. Outdoor burning is not recommended.

events.summary:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
South Central Garfield County in southern Utah...
Northeastern Kane County in southern Utah...

* Until 415 PM MDT Wednesday.

* At 1011 AM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of normally dry washes,
slot canyons, creeks, streams and the Escalante River.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
The Escalante River from south of Calf Creek to the terminus at
Lake Powell, as well as slot canyons near Hole-in-the-Rock Road
including Spencer, Tunnel, The Gulch, Red Breaks and Zebra.
